title: Trailer truck crashes into SLEX wall in Parañaque, causes heavy traffic
summary: A trailer truck crashed into the concrete wall of the South Luzon Expressway (SLEX) along the West Service Road in Parañaque on Friday morning, causing heavy traffic that stretched to Pasay.
